title: MoTo: A Zero-shot Plug-in Interaction-aware Navigation for General Mobile Manipulation
summary: A zero-shot interaction-aware navigation module that uses multi-view interaction keypoints and trajectory objectives to select manipulation-ready docking points.

mechanisms.name: Interaction-keypoint docking optimization
mechanisms.description: Matches target and arm interaction keypoints under multi-view consistency, then optimizes base and arm motion toward a physically feasible docking configuration.
mechanisms.limitations: Robot docking and manipulation success do not establish human-reachable stance, handheld localization, exact-instance identity, or safety.
